overview_description.description:
In Your Shoe is a local statement socks brand That focuses on making a thread for everyone, insisting on having a good quality product.

The company's brand is all about creating diverse statements and playful socks designs that cater to all different tastes and that are of high quality.

The company was founded in 2018.
